data.rationale: The proposal follows the same Wikipedia → Booking → Notes procedure with the right parameters, but it drops the "review score of 8 or more" criterion and the "do not reserve" constraint, and it adds unsupported Saturday–Sunday and French-city assumptions. It also never says how to pick the landmark, and it is vague about the date format and the note's check-in date, so an automation built from it would be underspecified.
